paragraphs: SwimEye designs and develops AI-powered camera systems for swimming pools. The company presents the product as a prevention and drowning detection system designed for all kinds of swimming pools, built on computer vision technology that monitors swimmers and detects signs of distress in real time. Cameras scan the pool and analyze movement patterns and behavior, and the system sends an alert to lifeguards when it detects a potential drowning situation.

The site names installations at the swimming facility at Kirkebygden School, at Stavanger Svømmehall in Stavanger, Norway, and at Austevollbadet in Storebø, Norway. The first system was installed at Stavanger Svømmehall in 2005. At Austevollbadet, drowning detection was installed in the deep end of a 25m swimming pool, giving lifeguards extra support in the most challenging part of their pool.
The pages describe the system as adding a layer of safety and giving peace of mind to pool operators and guests.

quote.text: SwimEye is a drowning detection and prevention system that will make your swimming pool safer.
